items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Rip is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: But the Spike brothers all dead now? Both brothers dead? I know.
I know. I saw where Johnny died, the piano player. I think Rip is still living here around Los Angeles. And where it...
Yeah, Rip had a band that recorded later for Columbia, didn't he? Was that his own band, Bill? Rip Spikes?
